subject: Courtyard Guard
text: Shooting the window on the left side of the courtyard with the Slingshot causes a guard to throw a bomb back at Link.

evidence.quote: Shoot the window on the left side of the courtyard with your Slingshot, and a guard will throw a bomb at you.

subject: Courtyard Window
text: Shooting the right courtyard window depicting Mario characters rewards a red rupee.

evidence.quote: Look at the window on the right, and you'll see images of Mario, Peach, Bowser and Yoshi.  Shoot this window for a red rupee.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Speaking with Princess Zelda in the courtyard leads to Link meeting her.

evidence.quote: Once you reach the northern edge of the topiary, run through the arch to reach the center of the Courtyard, and the Princess of Destiny: Zelda...After you've done this, speak with Zelda.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Agreeing to help Princess Zelda rewards Link with Zelda's Letter, which opens the gate to Death Mountain in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Agree to help her, and she will give you Zelda's Letter.  This will let you pass through the gate in Kakariko Village to Death Mountain.

subject: Impa
text: Impa blocks the exit from the courtyard and teaches Link Zelda's Lullaby before guiding him out to Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: Run towards the entrance to the courtyard, and you will find the way blocked by Impa, Zelda's attendant (basically, nurse/bodyguard).  Impa will teach you Zelda's Lullaby, easily the most important and overused song in the game.  Impa will then show you back outside to Hyrule Field, and point you in the direction of Kakariko Village.

subject: Hyrule Field
text: Heading south across Hyrule Field leads into the opening of Lon Lon Ranch during the daytime.

evidence.quote: Point yourself south, and head for the large structure whose opening is just visible.  Run straight through to the opening to enter Lon Lon Ranch.  Make sure it is daytime before you enter.

subject: Talon's Cucco Minigame
text: Finding all three special cuccos in Talon's minigame before time runs out rewards Link with a Bottle filled with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: He will throw three "special" cuccos into the pack of regular cuccos, and if you can find all three of the special cuccos before the time runs out, then he'll reward you with a Bottle, filled with Lon Lon Milk.

subject: Talon's Cucco Minigame
text: Talon's minigame can be simplified by throwing all the cuccos behind the counter where Talon sits before selecting the special ones.

evidence.quote: Or you can cheat by throwing all of the cuccos into the corner, behind the long counter that Talon sits on.  "Select" the Cuccos by picking them up.

subject: Malon
text: Speaking to Malon in the pasture until she mentions her mother and presenting the Ocarina prompts her to teach Epona's Song.

evidence.quote: Speak with Malon again until she mentions her mother, then whip out your Ocarina.  Malon will then teach you Epona's Song.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Playing Epona's Song for any cow in the game yields free Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: In addition to eventually letting you ride Epona later in the game, Epona's Song will also get you free Lon Lon Milk from ANY cow in the game.

subject: Mill Crate Tunnel
text: Pushing the milk crates in the corner of the Mill reveals a crawl tunnel leading to an empty nest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: In the corner of the room, there are a large number of milk crates...The X marks where a new tunnel will have appeared.  Crawl through the tunnel to find an empty nest, which houses a Piece of Heart.

subject: Pasture Tree Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling at night into the tree to the left of the pasture arch drops a Gold Skulltula holding a token.

evidence.quote: Run through the arch that leads to the pasture, and roll into the tree just to the left of the arch.  Kill the Gold Skulltula that falls down, and take it's token.

subject: Pasture Awning Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at night on the outer wall of the small awning behind the pasture.

evidence.quote: Now, circle around to the back of the pasture, so that you are on the outer wall of the small awning.  Kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token, but watch out for the Guay bird enemies.

subject: Hyrule Field
text: Traveling due east of Lon Lon Ranch across Hyrule Field leads to the Lost Woods Bridge entrance into Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Head back to Kokiri Forest now, which is at the three o'clock position on your map.  It's pretty much due east of Lon Lon Ranch.  Make sure it's nighttime, then enter the hollowed out log, run across the Lost Woods Bridge and enter Kokiri Forest.

subject: Know-It-All Brothers' House Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at night behind the Know-It-All Brother's House in Kokiri Forest, reachable by backflipping into its token.

evidence.quote: Climb the hill to your right as you enter, and go around to the rear of the Know-It-All Brother's House (the large, squat tree house with the giant leaf coming out of it's top).  Kill the Gold Skulltula back here, and grab the token by facing away from the token, holding down Z, and holding back and A to backflip into the token.

subject: Kokiri Forest Cliff
text: Climbing the ivy wall behind Mido's House leads to a hollowed log tunnel into the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Climb down to Mido's House, and climb up to the cliff behind his house.  Climb up the Ivy Wall, go around the corner of the cliff, and through the hollowed log to the Lost Woods.

subject: Target Tree Drum
text: Hitting the center of the hanging drum three consecutive times for 100 points with the Slingshot makes a Deku Scrub appear with the Bullet Bag x50.

evidence.quote: Shoot the drum hanging from the tree limb, and try to adjust your aim so that you hit the exact middle.  You'll know you've done it right, as it will give you 100 points...Three successive shots to the exact center of the drum will cause a Deku Scrub to appear, who will reward you with the Bullet Bag x50, the largest Slingshot ammunition bag in the game.

subject: Skull Kid Ocarina Minigame
text: Completing three rounds of the Ocarina memory game with the two Skullkids on the low tree trunk earns a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Stand on the low trunk, and two Skullkids will appear.  Take out your Ocarina, and play a lengthy memory game with them.  Complete the entire game (three rounds, each becoming increasingly longer and harder) to earn another Piece of Heart.

subject: Lost Woods
text: The stone arch near Kaepora Gaebora in the Lost Woods connects to Goron City, but requires proper equipment to use.

evidence.quote: If you're wondering, the stone arch here goes to Goron City, one of our next destinations.  Unfortunately, as of yet, we can't use this shortcut as we aren't properly equipped.

subject: Lost Woods Pool
text: The underwater pool in the Lost Woods leads to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: On the other side, there is a pool.  This pool leads to Zora's Domain, but as with the Goron City shortcut we're not properly equipped to use it yet.

subject: Lost Woods Path
text: From the pool room in the Lost Woods, taking the left tunnel, then straight, then left, and right at the crossroads enters the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote: Go left through another tunnel.  Go straight from here through another tunnel, then hang a left through another tunnel, then go right at the next crossroads to enter the Sacred Forest Meadow.
